title: Day at the Races Beer Julep
ldName: Day at the Races Beer Julep
ldInstructionsRaw: Add the lime juice, cane syrup, whiskey, and mint leaves to a shaker. Lightly muddle the mint. Add one ice cube and shake. Add the IPA, give it a quick swirl to chill and pour the contents into a rocks glass. Top with crushed ice. Add a few drops of Angostura bitters on top of the ice, then garnish.
